description: Send and return loop for the NAM Player, placed immediately to its right: it takes the amp model's output out to another module and mixes what comes back into the Player's own output jack

params.text: Fades between the signal the NAM Player sent and the signal arriving at the return jack, all send fully anticlockwise and all return fully clockwise

inputs.text: The effect's output coming back; unpatched, the sent signal is used in its place, so the blend control then has nothing to fade between

outputs.text: Whatever the NAM Player would otherwise have put out, for patching into an effect; it carries 0V when this module is not touching a NAM Player

notes: the blended result does not come out of this module: it goes back through the expander connection and out of the NAM Player's own output jack
the green lamp lights while a NAM Player is immediately to the left of this module
placed anywhere else, the send carries 0V and the return is ignored

inputs.0:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the send signal.
